work.intro: Every project starts from a real business problem. We show what we did, and what it produced.

bricodi.summary: Digital launch for a professional hardware and tools retailer.
bricodi.context: Bricodi Pro was preparing its launch phase and needed a consistent digital presence to introduce its offer to the market.
bricodi.approach: Adrar Media structured the launch around a consistent visual language, platform-ready social content and distribution focused on visibility.
deliverables: Editorial direction and social media content
Meta distribution monitoring and performance review
bricodi.disclosure: The only published figure is the result verified in the launch-phase data. No engagement rate, lead volume or commercial outcome is extrapolated.

bigFamily.summary: Building a premium image for a barbershop and beauty salon.
bigFamily.context: The Big Family wanted its social presence to feel consistent with the experience offered inside the salon.
bigFamily.approach: The collaboration structures messaging, visual direction and short-form content around a clear, recognisable image.
bigFamily.disclosure: This is a free-plan social media collaboration. No result is published until a verified measurement and publication approval are available.

wlidatna.summary: Social communication and content production for a local association supporting children with disabilities.
wlidatna.context: Wlidatna works in Azrou with children with disabilities and their families. Its communication needs to explain its actions with care, clarity and respect.
wlidatna.approach: Adrar Media supports its social presence through restrained creative direction, accessible video formats and an editorial structure suited to an association.
wlidatna.disclosure: This is a free-plan social media collaboration. The site describes the scope without publishing sensitive data, beneficiary testimonials or unverified results.
